(d)
the  licensee  has  contravened  any
provision  of  this  Act  or  the  National
Aquaculture development Authority of
Sri Lanka Act, No. 53 of 1998 or any
regulation made under those Acts ;

(e)
the licensee has acted in contravention

or 
in  violation  of  any 
terms  or
conditions  subject  to  which  such
licence was issued ; or

(f)
the  continuation  of  the  aquaculture
operation  would  have  an  adverse
impact on the environment.
(2) Where a licence issued is suspended or
cancelled as the case may be under section 43A
or  this  section,  it  shall  be  the  duty  of  the
Director-General  to  forthwith  inform  the
licensee of such suspension or cancellation, by
a written communication sent under registered
post to the address given by the licensee.
